title: SNAP + ENGINE
why: Yesterday's power session got cut short — the complex landed (and you set a new 7:46 mile warm-up), but the snatch power and tempo run never happened, so today picks both of those up. It's also day one under your two new standing rules: a real mobility warm-up and a dedicated core block at the end. Your legs and back are stiff (limberness, not fatigue), so the main work stays off heavy legs and off the spine — a ballistic snatch + press EMOM and a tempo run — and the core finisher is all anti-rotation/anti-extension, which doubles as low-back insurance. Mobility opens it, core closes it, ~60 min.

blocks.title: MOBILITY WARM-UP
blocks.meta: ~10 min · standing rule · chase the stiff back + hips
blocks.text: Easy jog 3 min @ 5.5 mph. Then Original Strength resets to un-stiffen the spine and hips: diaphragmatic breathing ×5 · head nods + slow rotations 5 each · quadruped rock-backs ×10 (segment the spine) · segmental rolling 3/side · baby-crawl or standing cross-crawl 30s. Then targeted mobility: cat-cow ×8 · thoracic open-book 5/side · 90/90 hip switches 6/side · world's-greatest-stretch 4/side · deep-squat pry ×5 (sit in it, pry the knees). Move slow, breathe into the stiff spots — this is now part of every session.

blocks.title: SNATCH + PRESS POWER
blocks.workRest: odd min = snatch, even min = press, rest the remainder of each minute
blocks.text: The ballistic power that got cut yesterday, kept off your sore legs. Alternating EMOM for 14 min: ODD minutes = 5 snatches per side, explosive hip snap, punch through the top and float it down. EVEN minutes = 8 push presses with a single 40, quick dip-drive, lock out tall. Rest whatever's left in each minute. Keep both crisp — if the reps slow, cut snatches to 8 and presses to 6. Set the EMOM timer to 14 rounds of 1:00.

blocks.title: TEMPO RUN
blocks.text: The tempo gear you missed yesterday. Hold 7.0 mph continuous — breathing hard but controlled, not gasping. Tall posture protects the back; quick, light feet. If the back or legs feel heavy after the mobility, drop to 6.3 mph and hold easy Zone 2 instead — don't grind it. Your warm-up mile is already at 7:46, so this steady tempo should feel strong.

blocks.title: CORE FINISHER
blocks.text: Your standing end-of-session core block — and it's low-back insurance. Anti-lateral (suitcase carry, stay stacked), anti-rotation (bird-dog, don't let the hips twist), anti-side-bend (side plank), anti-extension (dead bug, ribs down and low back glued to the floor). 3 rounds solid, 4 if you've got time. Brace hard, move slow — quality over speed. This is the piece that fixes the stiff back over the weeks.

blocks.title: COOLDOWN
blocks.text: Walk 2 min @ 3 mph. Then decompress the back: child's pose 45s · gentle prone press-up ×5 (easy back extension) · figure-4 glute stretch 30s/side · hamstring + hip-flexor stretch 30s each · 5 slow breaths. Revisit whatever was stiffest in the warm-up.
